methods.prepare: verify inputs, environment, version and locks; no production side effect
methods.submit: return run_id and true invocation status
methods.poll: actual process/tool status; do not infer success from PID
methods.cancel: acknowledge safe stop or report unknown/unsupported; no premature lock release
methods.check: independent check report; compiler/solver results retained
methods.resume: declare supported checkpoint granularity; otherwise minimal valid node rerun

idempotency: workstation TaskRun unique active key + callback event_id + operation ledger for non-idempotent tools
